geometry_nodes: [0,1/3,2/3,1] for both reference axes; these define geometry, not solution resolution
connectivity: connectivity[patch,u_index,v_index] indexes points; identical IDs on shared interfaces
interfaces: rows [patch_a,face_a,patch_b,face_b,reverse]; zero-based; reverse=1 reverses the tangential coordinate
boundaries: boundary.json contains patch, face, kind and bc; all boundary conditions are dirichlet_zero
limitations: Geometry and connectivity checked; Poisson MMS on these meshes is not yet run.
Domain classifier reconstructed from inspected Parallax source; not directly compared to Fortran.
Flux contours approximated using cubic interpolation and 1600 x 2400 extraction grids.
Positive Bernstein coefficients of det(DF) checked in floating point; no formal interval-arithmetic proof.
